answer: Registration burns credits on the ferrous ledger: each identity pays a base burn rising by a delta of 2 credits per registration in the same epoch, so the first burns 20, the 1000th burns 2018, and 1000 burn 1,019,000. A burn receipt is bound to one key and one epoch seed, so one receipt cannot register a second identity, and a reused receipt is rejected at the ridge board, which lists registrations in order for recomputation. A rented receipt fails because rewards go to its key owner, not the renter, and the burn is destroyed. An honest agent registers once and burns 20.
